description: This Swift source file defines a protocol `MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices` and its implementation `LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices`. It provides services related to screen recording and location management on macOS, utilizing system frameworks like CoreLocation. The class interacts with other services to perform screen recording and retrieve location data asynchronously.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: Implementation of `MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices` providing concrete functionality for screen recording and location services, designed to run on the main actor.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Asynchronously records the screen with specified parameters, returning the output path and audio status.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current location authorization status.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current location accuracy authorization.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with desired accuracy and optional maximum age and timeout.
